anomaly_signals.detail: 239 errors out of 485 spans (~49.3% error rate) and 246 genai_tool_failures recorded — nearly every other tool invocation is failing, triggering cascading failures upstream.
177 errors out of 490 spans (~36.1% error rate). Likely propagating failures from tool-executor, destabilising the agentic loop.
93 errors out of 490 spans (~19.0% error rate). Memory read/write failures are compounding agent context loss and retry storms.
67 errors out of 874 spans (~7.7% error rate) combined with a system-wide p99 of 32,693 ms strongly suggests LLM inference timeouts and upstream back-pressure contributing to the cascading failure.
26 token truncation events detected. Likely caused by bloated prompts from retry/context accumulation during the agentic failure loop.
44 errors out of 245 spans (~18.0% error rate). Orchestrator is struggling to manage failed agentic steps, suggesting inadequate dead-letter/fallback handling.
21 errors out of 418 spans (~5.0% error rate). Downstream payment processing is being affected, raising risk of incomplete financial transactions.

recommended_action: Immediately circuit-break tool-executor to halt the cascading failure loop; investigate and fix the root cause of tool invocation failures (misconfigured tools, downstream dependency outage, or malformed LLM-generated tool calls). Simultaneously throttle agent retry storms via workflow-orchestrator rate limits, stabilise memory-service, and review LLM prompt sizes to eliminate token truncations. Monitor payments-service closely for transaction integrity issues during the incident.
summary: A severe agentic cascading failure is active: tool-executor is failing on ~49% of invocations (246 genai_tool_failures), causing a chain reaction of errors through agent-service (36%), memory-service (19%), and workflow-orchestrator (18%), with a system-wide p99 latency of ~32.7 seconds and an 8.5% overall error rate. The LLM layer is exhibiting token truncations and elevated errors, indicating the agentic retry loop is amplifying prompt sizes and overwhelming the entire stack.
